note_tweet.text:
[trans] 

🎤: As for the latest trailer that was released, with various reactions and feedback, have you seen any of it?

🐰: I’ve looked at it briefly. 

🌻: We want everyone to wait and watch the final product with an open mind. You might experience something new from the series. There are several members of the team who have had the chance to watch it already and they said the vibe of the story isn't what they expected at all, not like the period setting they initially imagined. When they watched it, it gave off a more youthful vibe and a GMMTV feel. So we want everyone to wait and watch the full version. GMMTV feel in ways that It feels more youthful, it has a lively and colorful vibe.

🎤: There are both positive and negative feedbacks right? 

🌻: Yes, and we listen to all of it, because many people made recommendations with good intentions, wanting us to improve various aspects, so we are listening.

We want everyone to watch it fully first, to keep an open mind and not judge prematurely, so please support it. 😊

🐰: We really hope everyone will keep an open mind and give it a chance because the teaser we released is only about 2–3 minutes long. We hope everyone can look at it from a fresh perspective without being too attached to the original versions. Every country has its own unique charm, and the Thai version has its own charm too, presented in a more contemporary, GMMTV-style format, as Tu mentioned. We hope you’ll embrace it with an open heart. 😊

This is a film that will stay by your side for years to come.
